recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染色中，黑色纖維在多數細胞周圍形成緻密交錯的網絡，瀰漫全視野，代表網狀纖維明顯增加，是 CML 加速期伴隨巨核細胞增生時可見的骨髓纖維化。
features: Diffuse, dense network of black-staining reticulin fibers outlining most individual cells
Extensive fiber intersections throughout the field, well beyond perivascular foci
Hypercellular marrow with scattered megakaryocytes visible as larger pink cells
Thick coarse collagen bundles not clearly identified; trichrome would be needed to assess collagen
describe_en: Reticulin stain on a bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers with extensive intersections enveloping most hematopoietic cells, approximately MF-2 or higher on the WHO grading system; grading is best confirmed at lower power across the entire core. Thick collagen bundles cannot be reliably assessed on this stain. Marrow fibrosis in CML is associated with megakaryocytic proliferation and more advanced disease, and it may regress with tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.

ddx.vs: PMF shows similar fibrosis but with atypical clustered megakaryocytes with cloud-like nuclei, osteosclerosis and a BCR::ABL1-negative JAK2/CALR/MPL-driven clone.
Post-PV myelofibrosis follows documented polycythemia vera with a JAK2 mutation and lacks BCR::ABL1.
HCL also produces diffuse reticulin fibrosis but with evenly spaced cells having a fried-egg appearance and CD20/annexin A1 positivity.
